notes: Real FW13.52 profile promoted from W9 live attestation evidence (2026-10-05) plus the pinned FW13.52 research. Identity basis: seven STRICT_FINGERPRINT windows of the kernel image matched the live kernel byte for byte (host-verified), so the firmware family 13.52 is derived from kernel evidence and NOT from the userland kern.sdk_version value. No runtime address (LSTAR, kbase, KASLR slide, aperture value) is stored here: those live in runtime evidence and runtime bindings only. aperture_global is STRUCTURAL_ONLY by agreement and is never part of the identity. Console identity from the capture dossier (/home/hermes/audits/playstation-ps4/fw1352-ps4b-20260920/README.md, sha256 9563bc80304707310027a0c6d64351d7dfab16e08e526e27e98270265402cc39). SCOPE: this profile evidences the kernel attestation windows only. Gated operations whose locator is not evidenced here carry profile_required=true with locator_ref=null (explicitly pending) and refuse with LOCATOR_MISSING; the binding authority for them stays the W4 requirement table, and no boot binding exists yet either, so privileged providers remain deferred. REVISION 2 (CCP/P4 pull-forward, 2026-10-07, candidate): adds the keymgr/CCP binding locators (ccp.submit.entry 0x625330, keymgr.claim.entry 0x62C570, keymgr.release.entry 0x62C610, keymgr.bind.entry 0x62BF50, keymgr.snapshot.pool 0x266C8E0 structural, ccp.device_gate 0x3B2EE0) and binds ccp.submit / keymgr.claim / keymgr.release / keymgr.snapshot to them. All new facts are offline byte fingerprints of the pinned image (confidence OBSERVED): they are NOT live-attested, so this revision is a candidate and grants nothing until review + promotion; identity windows, target block and every other operation policy entry are unchanged from revision 1. Layouts and the provider binding rationale live in profiles/fw1352/ccp-layouts.json; the acceptance spec is docs/P4-CCP-ACCEPTANCE-REQ.md.
